notes.title: Zilar: Empire Of The Underground Demo Gameplay
notes.content: [p][/p][h2][b][i]Zilar: Empire of the Underground[/i][/b][/h2][p][b][i] is an exploration and adventure game that begins with our main character, Zemandev, losing the magical crown inherited from his ancestor, Zonaran.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124054/04f9ab70dc83dde72ef60d8e01092f0cfdcb095b.png"][/img][/p]
